scope: Detailed optical support/workfield correction, native contact coverage and retained table/mechanism regression checks.
changes: Set the fixed SZ51 focus support back 20 mm, extend the guide running faces and add a distinct moving rear pad, neck and dovetail carriage.

Replace the bulky vertical collet with a narrow descending taper swept rearward; move the visible yoke, transducer, rods and spool structure back 10 mm without moving the tip, shank, benchmark pads or contact targets.
Add native lower-sleeve cylinders, front-glass contact and 24 illuminator-ring segments; retain the 40 N focus-force cap and apply a 5 mm/s focus target slew.
Regenerate ten source-matched stills and three identical-camera comparisons. The geometric pupil view disables depth of field in memory only, with the exact override recorded.
Preserve the separate upper head/lower hand lever, 8:1 equivalent coupling, reference5 metal finishes, heater mica maps and platen/chip contacts.

findings.finding: The molded optical shell intersected the fixed fork, dovetail or buried screws in all 32 sampled source configurations.
findings.correction: Set-back fork and explicit moving carriage clear the optical shell in all 32 source poses and 28 measured frames.

findings.finding: All 33 sampled pupil-to-pad/tip rays were obstructed by the oversized front collet.
findings.correction: The tapered collet and set-back yoke open a shared front-aperture point to both benchmark pads. 28 of 33 sampled rays remain blocked by opaque hardware; central/underside visibility is not claimed.

findings.finding: The moving microscope assembly had no native contact geometry.
findings.correction: Add lower optics contacts and validate inserted-probe fixture/external-force stops, retraction, offset-probe and contacts-disabled causal controls, separately from the clear original operating envelope.

superseded_attempts.reason: The first support/contact correction still left the yoke blocking both front pupil paths. This attempt is rejected; final geometry_acceptance.json is authoritative.

notes: Inspected all ten final views for separate head/handle construction, focus support, workfield, heater construction, rear service connections and deck clearance.
Inspected guide, workfield and pupil before/after pairs at the same camera signatures. The final pupil view is a clearly labeled pinhole geometric diagnostic, not a factory optical channel.

limitations: The audit covers the listed optical assemblies, sampled poses and measured approach/retraction trajectories; arbitrary robot approaches are not certified.
Reference images establish visible construction; mount dimensions, optical prescriptions and material/force parameters remain uncalibrated.
Flexible services retain prescribed visual deformation without contact or strain dynamics.
Pupil rays demonstrate geometric access to both pads. They do not reconstruct the unknown internal stereo channels or claim that opaque tools never obscure the specimen.
The probe force test explicitly inserts a temporary obstacle below the glass; it is not delivered instrument hardware. The existing operating envelope is tested separately and remains clear.
Focus wheels remain visual controls; the axial focus slide has finite-force fixture actuation and native lower-optics contacts.
The 20 mm support setback, 10 mm visible head setback and collet proportions are photo-supported reconstruction dimensions, not factory measurements.
The 8:1 coupling is an equivalent small-displacement mechanism; it does not reconstruct the concealed closed-chain linkage.
Tool forces, ultrasound, heat and actual bond formation remain uncalibrated.
private_reference_policy: Raw laboratory photos/video remain private. Only generated model renders and non-image validation evidence are promoted.
freeze_manifest_note: The immutable source freeze recorded stills_pending=true at its creation. This later summary records completed render inspection and promotion without rewriting that earlier freeze.
